# Third-party notices

The offline extract.js bundle uses Readability 0.6.0, LinkeDOM worker 0.18.12 and Turndown 7.2.5. The LinkeDOM worker includes its parser and selector dependencies. The build replaces its two Array.at(0) title lookups with equivalent [0] access for Chrome 83; no global DOM is installed.

Sources:
- https://github.com/mozilla/readability
- https://github.com/WebReflection/linkedom
- https://github.com/mixmark-io/turndown

The following notices accompany these libraries and their bundled dependencies. Defuddle is a design reference only; no Defuddle source code is included.
